latest_cos_commentary.headline: All Gravy is a Copenhagen-founded, UK-focused employee engagement and workforce app for frontline hospitality staff, used by UK restaurant groups like Dishoom and Honest Burgers.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on back_office/labor engagement adjacent features (staff communications, scheduling-adjacent engagement) rather than core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: March 2025 funding round ($2.9M) is fueling UK expansion; the company is small-scale relative to US enterprise workforce platforms.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Primarily a UK/European market player; unlikely to be encountered in US enterprise restaurant deals today.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Small company on a recent $2.9M raise; customer base skews UK independent/multi-unit groups, not proven at large US chain scale.
